description: This file defines an enumeration 'SqlOperator' that encapsulates various SQL comparison operators used within the Fineract project. It provides methods to format SQL snippets, handle placeholders, and validate parameter counts for these operators.

classes.name: SqlOperator
classes.description: An enum representing various SQL comparison operators with methods to generate SQL snippets with proper formatting, placeholders, and validation.

methods.name: formatImpl
methods.description: Formats the SQL representation of the operator with given SQL generator, column type, and SQL definition.

methods.name: formatPlaceholderImpl
methods.description: Provides the SQL snippet for the operator using placeholders, allowing parameter binding.

methods.name: formatNamedParam
methods.description: Creates a named parameter SQL snippet for the operator, validating parameter count.

methods.name: formatPlaceholder
methods.description: Generates SQL with positional placeholders, specifying the placeholder character.

methods.name: validateValues
methods.description: Validates the number of values provided according to the operator's required parameter count.

methods.name: validateParamCount
methods.description: Ensures the number of parameters matches the operator's expected count, throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Returns the SqlOperator enum constant matching the provided string name.
